<!-- Shared body of each failing packages page. Each page sets `branch` and
     includes this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
# Use a local biocUniTools checkout if BIOCUNITOOLS_SRC points to one, so
# changes to its R/ show up without reinstalling
src <- Sys.getenv("BIOCUNITOOLS_SRC")
if (nzchar(src)) {
    pkgload::load_all(src, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
    library(biocUniTools)
}
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config.yml")
files <- file.path("..", config$data_dir,
                   sprintf("compare-%s-%s.rds", branch, config$types))
files <- files[file.exists(files)]
cmps <- lapply(files, readRDS)
has_data <- length(cmps) > 0 &&
    all(vapply(cmps, function(x) "uni_n_revdeps" %in% names(x), logical(1)))
if (has_data) {
    failing <- compare_failing(cmps)
    types <- bioc_pkg_types()
    counts <- table(factor(failing$type, levels = config$types))
    by_type <- paste(sprintf("%s %s", counts,
                             tolower(types$label[match(names(counts),
                                                       types$type)])),
                     collapse = ", ")
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet, or it is from an older version of biocUniTools. Run",
        "`biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("# Failing packages: Bioconductor %s (%s)\n\n",
                cmps[[1]]$bioc_version[1], branch))
    cat(sprintf('<p class="text-body-secondary">Updated %s</p>\n\n',
                format(attr(cmps[[1]], "created"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")))
    cat(sprintf("%s packages fail in BBS or R Universe on %s: %s.",
                format(nrow(failing), big.mark = ","), config$platform,
                by_type),
        "Sorted by downloads.\n\n")
}
```

<details>
<summary>Legend</summary>

- **BBS**: the first stage that fails: install, build, or check, with ERROR or
  TIMEOUT. Links to the BBS log.
- **R Universe**: the first job that fails: source build or check, with
  ERROR, FAIL, or TIMEOUT, or the overall status if only that failed. Links to
  the job.
- **Downloads / month**: distinct IPs downloading the package from
  Bioconductor in the last 12 months, divided by 12.
- **Strong reverse deps**: Bioconductor packages that depend on, import, or
  link to the package. Expand a row to see them and the packages that suggest
  it.
- **Mentions** (R Universe `_mentions`): mentions in scientific papers.
- **Commits (12 weeks)** (R Universe `_updates`): commits in the last 12
  weeks, a sign the maintainer is working on the package.

</details>

if (has_data) failing_table(failing)
